verses.1: The songs that rise from the depths, O LORD, you are called upon to hear them.
verses.2: O Adonai, may your ears be attentive to my voice. May your ears be ready to hear the sound of my call.
verses.3: If they are not kept safe, then who will stand against them?
verses.4: Since you have forgiveness, let it be your reward.
verses.5: I cried out to the LORD; my soul and my words were filled with sorrow.
verses.6: My soul belongs to the Lord; they keep it in the morning, and they continue to keep it throughout the day.
verses.7: Israel shall begin to worship Yahweh, for with Yahweh comes grace and many blessings.
verses.8: And he will save Israel from all its troubles.
